{{Quote|Perfection is my art, sergeant. It will be my honor to help you perform at your very best.|Lieutenant Ryler Dorant|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Ryler Dorant''', also known as '''Needles''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]]<ref name="SWTORTPOD">{{TORcite|type=general|The Cult of Ki Sazen|Taris}}</ref> who was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in [[Havoc Squad]], an elite team of [[Republic trooper]]s serving in the [[Republic Military|military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He, along with most of Havoc Squad, joined the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the Republic.

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Ryler served as Havoc Squad's [[Medic/Legends|medic]], in which he was primarily focused into synthesizing combat [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]], part of the larger [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that began when the returned [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Treaty of Coruscant|ended]] their [[Great Galactic War|invasion]]. During the Separatist War, he and the rest of Havoc Squad defected to the Sith Empire, with the exception of [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|one member]].

Needles eventually traveled to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and weaponized the [[rakghoul]] [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|plague]]. With the intention of making it fast acting, he tested it on newly defected Republic troops and captives brought to him by the [[Death's Claw]] pirates of [[Fallenspire Stronghold]]. The new Havoc Squad, led by the original member who did not defect, managed to stop and kill Needles, ending his experiments. His position in Havoc Squad was later filled by [[Elara Dorne]].

[[Dorant's laboratory]] was later sought out by the rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ki Sazen]], who sought his research on the rakghoul virus as part of her plot to create a rakghoul army with Doctor [[Nasan Godera]]'s [[Ultrawave Transmitter]] and take control of the planet.
